checks.name: ctl_om9_no_cross_identity_wipe
checks.detail: CTL counterexample of length 8 found (9-state trace). Two identities register plans (SetPlanManual for AGENTID1, then AGENTID2), AGENTID1's own session ends (correctly clearing only its own key), then AGENTID1's next StartSession fires the pre-fix global wipe (planSet' = empty), clearing AGENTID2's still-set plan too. That counterexample IS biff-om9.

notes: planWiped is NOT pinned as a State invariant -- confirmed empirically that pinning it makes ProB filter violating successors out of the reachable graph (a false-negative 'no counterexample, all states visited') rather than report them. It is checked exclusively via the explicit CTL formula above, matching nats-relay.tex's spuriousTeardown idiom.

This harness is a formal projection of claude-code-biff.tex onto {sessionPhase, sessionId, planSet, planSource, planWiped} -- the full combined base-Claude-Code+biff spec (11 given types, 26 operations) is too large for probcli to close exhaustively within a practical time budget; see claude-code-biff.tex Section 'Identity-Indexed Plan State' for the full account.
The identical harness with the fix applied (override-based StartSession, verbatim from the shipped spec) proves the same CTL formula TRUE, exhaustively, over 9 total reachable states in under 30ms.
